title: The boundaries of spiritual guidance
intro: These terms keep the service honest, respectful, and clear about what it is—and is not.

sections.heading: Reflective service
sections.body: Guidance is for reflection and personal meaning, not a guaranteed prediction or fixed result.

sections.heading: Professional care
sections.body: Spiritual guidance does not replace medical, mental-health, legal, or financial advice.

sections.heading: Respectful contact
sections.body: We do not support harassment, coercion, hate, or fear-based demands for payment.
